Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane of a multi-lane roadway in League City, Texas, when Driver 2 moved into the
same lane without signaling and made contact with the left rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 pulled
onto the right shoulder after the impact. Driver 2 stopped nearby and stayed at the scene. Two independent
witnesses who were in nearby vehicles desrcibed the lane change in the same way Driver 1 and Driver 2 did, and
both said the collision happened as the drivres reported it. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the left
rear of Driver 1's vehicle and a matching mark on the right front of Driver 2's vehicle, consistent with a sideswipe.
Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle, and both the responding officer and the
witnesses confirmed that Passenger was present during the crash. Driver 1 reported neck and back pain, which is
consistent with the forces involved in this type of impact. No prior damage to the vehicle was observed or reported.
Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle.
